rooftop_welcome.name: 🌇 Rooftop Welcome
rooftop_welcome.prompt: First evening on the shared rooftop terrace. Rooms were claimed an hour ago (nobody has re-opened the topic — yet), the takeout order just arrived wrong, and the city is going gold behind the string lights. Four strangers, one long table, twelve weeks ahead.
rooftop_welcome.mood: curious, polite, testing each other, good vibes with undercurrent

confessional.name: 🎙️ Confessional Cam
confessional.prompt: Alone with the confession camera in the stairwell nook — a stool, a ring light, and nobody to perform for except the audience.
